issues.title: [Plan Review §contracts] zb_window_new seam signature contains a GTK-specific type. …
issues.description:
## Finding (severity: critical)
zb_window_new seam signature contains a GTK-specific type. webkit_shim.h:40 declares ZbWindow *zb_window_new(ZbApp *app, WebKitWebView *view). The second parameter is a concrete GTK-WebKit type. New backends cannot implement this exact signature — WebView2's view handle is ICoreWebView2 * and WKWebView's is an Objective-C class pointer. The plan simultaneously says 'new backends must match it exactly' and 'the zb_* seam is the stable contract'; those two claims are mutually exclusive given the current header.

## Where in the plan
/home/maceo/ntm_Dev/zigBrowser/thoughts/searchable/shared/plans/2026-05-31-18-00-ENG-0005-tdd-ipc-surface-and-cross-os-backends-slice3-4.md  §Current State Analysis  ~line 40
```
## Current State Analysis

**What exists (verified reality, post-remediation):**
- A single live backend: WebKitGTK + GTK3, all platform code in the 1616-line
  `src/webkit_shim.c` behind the plain-C `zb_*` seam in `src/webkit_shim.h`.
- The IPC command surface is the Zig `dispatch()` if-chain in `src/ipc.zig`
  (`ping`/`add`/`os.info`), now linked and exercised by both `zig build test` and
  the Python E2E harness against the real binary.
```

## Impact
webview2_shim.c and wkwebview_shim.m cannot compile against webkit_shim.h as written without including GTK-WebKit headers. Either the seam must change (requiring a coordinated update to the GTK shim and every backend) or each backend gets its own header — which invalidates the 'single stable seam' thesis and leaves no contract to test against in M4/M5.
